description: Closed set of tags an order line may carry. The order step picks ids from this list. It does not invent labels.

tags.label: Comfort
tags.description: A familiar pick when the listening mix is narrow.

tags.label: Familiar
tags.description: Repeats a category the listener already stays with.

tags.label: Classic
tags.description: A standard menu item rather than a one-off.

tags.label: High energy
tags.description: Fits a hotter tempo, when the calorie budget has room.

tags.label: Sweet
tags.description: A sweet item, usually the dessert.

tags.label: Side
tags.description: The side that goes with the main.

tags.label: One drink
tags.description: The single drink the rules allow.

tags.label: Variety
tags.description: A pick from another category when the listening is diverse.

tags.label: Light
tags.description: A smaller item when the budget is tight.

tags.label: Indulgent
tags.description: A richer item when the budget has room.
